messages:
Tess (PM): Quick async check-in on the quarterly milestone: routing+fallback (OKR: reduce p50 tail by 20%). One-line status per owner: shipped / slipped / in-flight, owner, blockers, ETA. Reply with short line. cc @Ravi @Lina @Kai

Ravi (Eng): Shipped -> canary routing + fallback deployed to staging and EU canary at 10%. Owner: Ravi. Blockers: observed a small tail bump at seq>2k in one app; investigating whether it's batching config. ETA for mitigation: 48h. @Kai I think autoscale rules might be amplifying the queuing. PR: https://git.company/pr/4821

Lina (Eng-ML): Slipped -> model quant patch for 4-bit path regressed on long-context perf (latency +2.3%). Owner: Lina. Blockers: need a new kernel selector + repro harness on longer sequences. ETA: 3 business days for a hotfix + eval. CR ping to @Ravi for integration tests on PR #4821 when ready.

Kai (Platform): In-flight -> autoscale policy merged to staging (policy v3). Owner: Kai. Blockers: redis key TTL needs bump to avoid premature cache eviction; will roll tonight. No infra capacity blocker. I'll add a short-runbook for rollback.

Omar (Design): Shipped -> error UX and fallback banner landed in staging, design review complete. Minor copy tweak requested for low-latency mode.

Ravi (Eng): Quick follow-up: repro snippet I used:
```
seq_len=2048 
workload=continuous_stream
./perf_probe --batch=auto --kv-cache=true
```
Gives tail at ~95th. If Lina can repro on that snippet it'll speed fixes. Also tagging @Tess for rollout decision if we see >5% tail regressions at canary.

Tess (PM): TL;DR next steps: 1) Lina: cut quant hotfix and run the perf harness (ETA 3d). 2) Ravi: experiment with batch cap and share numbers here (ETA 48h). 3) Kai: bump redis TTL and publish rollback runbook (ETA tonight). 4) Omar: ship copy tweak if small. If canary shows >5% tail regression after Lina's fix, we pause rollout and switch traffic to fallback model variant. CR ask: @Ravi please review model integration PR #4821 by EOD so we can merge into staging.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging succeeded for service/model-routing at 1759877600 — image: model-routing:v2026-09-05.

Lina (Eng-ML): Acked. I'll post a short perf table here once I run the harness.

Ravi (Eng): Will ping when I have batch cap results. If anyone needs me to revert canary earlier I can do that.

Tess (PM): Thanks everyone — reply only if you have a blocker or contradicting ETA. Otherwise I'll collate and update the milestone doc later today. :white_check_mark:
